messages:
Priya (PM): Quick huddle 1: we need an unambiguous rule for "MVP vs v1 cuts" before next week's stakeholder review. Last-minute scope creep killed our timeline last quarter. Proposing a single-source-of-truth cutlist and a frozen branch policy after feature-freeze. Thoughts?
Lena (Eng): Strong +1. Implementation detail: declare "cutlist.json" in repo root, owned by PM. Any change after feature-freeze requires a "cut-override" PR with approvals from PM + Eng lead + one customer advocate. No ad-hoc Slack approvals.
Omar (Design): From experience, we need staged UX toggles for any cut that affects flow. If we cut an onboarding step, design must supply fallback screens within 24h or feature stays for pilot tenants.
Renee (SRE): Also suggest a measurable launch gate: if pilot error budget consumed > 25% in last 7 days, escalate to timeline review. Add an "emergency unfreeze" flow: ops can request a 4-hr unblock window with PM+Eng concurrence.
deploy-bot: Canary for mvp-2026-cuttest started at 2026-03-23T16:45:00Z; canary=10%; healthchecks enabled.
Priya (PM): Decision knobs: 1) freeze branch 2) cutlist file required 3) PR approval gate 4) emergency unfreeze with timebox 5) migrations are prohibited after freeze unless signed-off by security & customer. Any objections?
Lena (Eng): We'll enforce via CI: merges to release branch blocked without a cutlist-present check and required reviewers. I'll add the pipeline job.
Omar (Design): I'll prepare fallback assets and a small checklist for any UX-impacting cut.
Renee (SRE): I'll add the pilot error-budget check to the launch dashboard and document the emergency unfreeze runbook.
Priya (PM): Action items: - Priya: publish cutlist template + owners - Lena: CI gate job + merge policy - Omar: UX fallback checklist - Renee: dashboard + runbook. Target: have infra + docs ready by Wed EOD.
Lena (Eng): Acknowledged, starting CI job now.
Priya (PM): Thanks all 1: locking this as the pre-launch cut governance process unless there are objections by EOD tomorrow.
